$description: Opal, Lolly's own design system and the first one built on Lolly. Every colour is a treat or a piece of nature, remembered by name and never by number; a tint keeps its parent's name. Liquorice is the ink, Sugar the paper, Spearmint the light accent and Green Apple the dark one, and green stays a quiet nod to the family Lolly grew up in. Outfit sets headings, SUSE the text and italics, SUSE Mono the code; all three are served by the shell, so this pack ships no font files. Layered DTCG in the starter's shape: a shared 'base' set (named colours, the chart spectrum, faces and logo slots) plus light and dark sets with the seven semantic slots and the slide roles.

brand.$description: Opal's named colours. What each one is for travels in its tools.lolly.opal extension. Greens, the main brand hue (Spearmint, Bunyapine, Green Apple, and the lighter Wattle, Pandanus and Avocado), earth (Basalt, Bauxite, Bark), relief (Banksia, Honey, Olive), dramatic relief (Reef), treats (Donut, Waffle), light and ink (Sugar, Meringue, Beach, Pebble, Liquorice), the flowers (Jacaranda, and Fuchsia after Correa, the native fuchsia) and the reds Lolly needs as an app (Arvo, Outback, Ochre).
